v14-7.candidate: He gathered many captives and gained control of Gazara, Beth-zur, and the citadel. He removed its uncleannesses, and there was no one to oppose him.
v14-7.close: He gathered many who had been captive and gained control of Gazara, Beth-zur, and the citadel. He removed its uncleannesses, and there was no one to oppose him.
v14-7.display:
He gathered many captives
and gained control of Gazara, Beth-zur, and the citadel.
He removed its uncleannesses,
and there was no one to oppose him.

v14-4.display:
The land of Judah was quiet all the days of Simon.
He sought good things for his nation,
and his authority and glory pleased them
all his days.

v14-5.display:
Among all his glorious deeds he took Joppa as a harbour
and made an entrance to the islands of the sea.

v14-6.display:
He enlarged the borders of his nation
and gained control of the country.

v14-10.display:
He supplied food to the cities
and equipped them with means of defence,
until the fame of his glory reached the end of the earth.

v14-13.display:
Those who fought them ceased from the land,
and the kings were crushed in those days.

v14-14.display:
He strengthened all the lowly of his people.
He sought out the law
and removed every lawless and wicked person.

v14-15.display:
He glorified the holy places
and multiplied the vessels of the holy places.
